function.name: execute_bash
function.description: Run a shell command or test suite in the local project directory.

command.description: The exact shell command to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Safely read the text content of a local project file.

path.description: Relative path to the target file.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file at a specified path.

path.description: Relative path to the target file.

content.description: The exact text content to write to the file.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Make a precise modification to an existing file by replacing a unique block of text (oldText) with a new block of text (newText).

path.description: Relative path to the file to modify.

oldText.description: The exact, unique block of text to be replaced.

newText.description: The new block of text to replace it with.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: Recursively list files in the current workspace, ignoring node_modules and version control directories.

path.description: Relative path to listing start. Defaults to the root directory.

function.name: grep_search
function.description: Search for occurrences of a text pattern across the codebase.

query.description: The search term or pattern to look for.

function.name: git_commit
function.description: Stage all current modifications and commit them to the git repository.

message.description: A concise commit message describing the changes.
